Lamar Jackson missed three games with the high ankle sprain, and Baltimore expects him back at BUF.

QB4 for me this week. Monitor Wednesday's injury report.
#RavensFlock

Trey McBride played 93 percent of the snaps vs DEN and caught 10 of 13 targets for 111 and a TD.

TE1 for me this week at DAL.
#BirdGang

Saquon Barkley hurt his back and tweaked the hamstring vs DAL, and he says he plays Sunday night.

RB18 for me this week, an RB2. Monitor Wednesday's Eagles report.
#FlyEaglesFly

Matthew Golden missed Monday's walkthrough with the shoulder and foot before Thursday vs CAR.

WR11 for me, borderline WR1/WR2 this week. Monitor Wednesday's Packers report.
#GoPackGo

Breece Hall is targeting a Week 8 return from the quad.
Braelon Allen led the backfield while he sat.

Hall is RB20 for me vs LV, an RB2. Allen is RB27, a high-end RB3.
#JetUp

DJ Moore is due back from the shoulder after the bye.

WR17 for me vs BAL, a WR2.
#BillsMafia

Jordan Mason ran 15 times for 68 at IND in his first game off IR, and Aaron Jones Sr. hurt his knee.

Mason is RB22 for me at DET, an RB2.
#Skol

Jeremiyah Love is back at practice for Arizona.
Bam Knight and Tyler Allgeier split the work vs DEN.

Love is RB24 for me at DAL, an RB2. Monitor Wednesday's report.
#BirdGang

Specials.

Omar Cooper Jr. ran 70 percent of the routes in Week 7. WR23 for me vs LV, a WR2.

Jonah Coleman led Denver's backs with 49 percent of the snaps. RB30 for me vs KC, a high-end RB3.
#JetUp #BroncosCountry

Antonio Williams led the WAS receivers in snaps in Week 6. WR38 for me vs PHI, a low-end flex play to a dart throw.

Makai Lemon played 91 percent of the snaps in Week 7. WR39 for me at WAS, a low-end flex play to a dart throw.
